scope: LLM interpretation of original visual goals and preservation constraints in the existing planning call, followed by enforced control/target/number validation
representative_user_request: 灯光再亮一些，不要让物体背光

backend.kind: Actual Python/Flask planning and temporary project storage with controlled AI replies; real local Blender synthetic scene regressions included

frontend.kind: Actual HTML and app JavaScript in jsdom with controlled APIs; no browser pixel audit

static_checks.kind: HTML references, ARIA reference integrity, JavaScript syntax and CSS parsing; no pixel/browser accessibility audit

notes: Before v11 the exact screenshot request was rejected by deterministic unknown-negative preflight before any model call; a pure negative visual goal could be incorrectly reported as preservation-only no_change.
Configured context-aware LLM requests now receive unresolved language verbatim. Offline/legacy routes and explicit unsupported capability boundaries remain strict.

The same planning response contains optional per-requirement visual_goal, adjustment or preservation interpretation; unresolved negative or unclassified executable clauses require this interpretation.
Semantic visual goals can choose supported photographic/framing/background controls. Explicit named controls, numbers, immutable locks and actual material/pose target evidence remain authoritative.

Resolved preservation locks are unioned with hard protections across every row, carried into candidate/history/receipt and retained verbatim in partial execution and remaining text. Unresolved genuine preservation cannot be silently dropped.
Every correction attempt starts from original requirements/protections, so invalid model responses cannot contaminate the retry or duplicate relative adjustments.
Vague brightness no longer causes arbitrary rule-injected exposure when the model chose valid key/fill controls. Metadata does not prove that subjective quality has already been achieved.

The source snapshot guard now applies to full lighting commits as well as partial/material commits. Input image bytes, evidence, plan, analysis and metadata are guarded; read-only diagnosis refresh remains allowed.
V10 automatic independent partial commits, compact UI, remaining-only follow-up, idempotent replay, undo and preview recovery are retained.
The normal planning call includes semantic understanding; planning and correction retain the two-call ceiling. No automatic provider/model upgrade was introduced; GPT-5.5 remains blocked.
Two original missing-fixture errors remain errors, not passes. Actual cabinet geometry, live provider understanding success and its final rendered appearance remain outside this verification.
